name: Phani Mohanty/ଫନୀ ମହାନ୍ତି

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Phani Mohanty is an Odia poet whose literary career developed alongside his work teaching philosophy in Odisha’s government colleges. His poetry collection Mrugaya received the Sahitya Akademi Award in 2009. His books also include Visadayoga, available in English translation by Aswini Kumar Mishra, and Priyatama.

In “ନିରୁତ୍ତର”, his contribution to Kabita Live’s first edition, a speaker addresses Mona through sensuous images of fallen leaves, blue lotus feet, silk, sandalwood and a flute’s music. The abundance of description gives way to repeated questions about belonging. The poem leaves the beloved’s answer suspended, allowing longing to remain its final note.
